bot.hello: Welcome to Anood in China! I'm the AI assistant. Ask me about scholarships, universities, documents and deadlines. How can I help?
bot.eligibility: Hello! Requirements depend on the level: for a Bachelor's we prefer a GPA above 75% and age under 25. A Master's requires a Bachelor's degree and age under 35. You can submit your papers for a direct evaluation with the apply button!
bot.csc: The government scholarship (CSC) covers full tuition and housing with a monthly stipend (3,000 CNY for Master's students). University or provincial scholarships cover tuition fully or partially. Our team picks the best option for your GPA!
bot.docs: The core documents are: 1. Transcript and certificate (translated and notarized) 2. Valid passport 3. Approved medical exam 4. Police clearance 5. Two recommendation letters. You can upload them through the portal.
bot.deadline: September intake applications usually open in November and close between March and April. Early March-intake applications open after September 20! We recommend preparing early to secure a seat.
bot.fees: Application fees vary by university and major (the university application fee is around 800 CNY). Applying through our site lets you see all packages and services transparently.
bot.airport: Absolutely! Our team in China (such as Shanghai Genius Students) picks you up at the airport, arranges your SIM card, university housing and a halal welcome meal, and stays with you until registration is complete!
bot.medicine: Yes, scholarships for general medicine (MBBS) are available at several universities and some include a monthly stipend. Tell me your GPA and I will suggest the best fit.
bot.language: English-taught programs usually require IELTS 6.0+, TOEFL 80+ or Duolingo 105+. Chinese-taught programs require HSK 4, 5 or 6. You are exempt if your previous degree was taught in English and verified.
bot.visa: After admission the university issues the admission letter and the JW201 or JW202 form, and we prepare a step-by-step visa guide for you to apply at the Chinese embassy.
bot.unis: We work with universities in Shanghai, Beijing, Nanjing, Hangzhou and Jinan, including Fudan, Southeast and Shandong. Browse the directory and filter by city and major.
bot.human: I have transferred you to an advisor from our team who will reply during working hours. You can also leave your request through the apply form so we reach you faster.
bot.fallback: Good question! I don't have a confirmed answer right now and I don't want to give you wrong information. Type "advisor" and I will transfer you to our team, or try asking about scholarships, documents or deadlines.
